name: Tailliuir Network Helper
description:
🚀💥 ATTENTION ALL USERS! PLEASE READ THIS CRITICAL SYSTEM NOTICE BEFORE STARTING YOUR STREAMING SESSION! 💥🚀

🔴 [RULE 1]: ALWAYS DEPLOY AND USE THE OFFICIAL TAILLIUIR NETWORK STREAMS FIRST! They are specifically tuned for premium performance! 💎📡

🔴 [RULE 2]: OBSERVE THE SPEED TRAFFIC LIGHTS! 🟢 Green = Maximum speed and perfect reliability. 🟡 Amber = Stable stream with potential minor congestion. 🔴 Red = Heavy load or slower response times. Check before you click! 🚦📊

🔴 [RULE 3]: BACKUP ADDONS ARE FOR EMERGENCIES ONLY! If and only if the Tailliuir streams are completely congested or busy, you may fall back to alternative options available down the list. 🔄⚠️

🔴 [RULE 4]: THE 4K ULTRACLEAN BAN! DO NOT SELECT OR CLICK ANY 4K STREAMS IF YOUR HARDWARE IS NOT FULLY 4K COMPATIBLE! Doing so will result in a black screen, application crashes, or zero playback! 🚫📺❌

 FAILURE TO FOLLOW THESE RULES MAY RUIN YOUR VIEWING EXPERIENCE! ENJOY STREAMING RESPONSIBLY! 🎉🍿🎬
